segments.text: Okay, this is genuinely one of the best home upgrades we've ever made.

If you're new here, hey, I'm Michael, and welcome back to Home Upgrades That Are Actually Worth It. In the last episode, we talked about what changes we made to our kitchen and our bedroom, and this summer the living room was next on the list.

Because here's the thing, our living room is where we spend all our time. It's where the kids play, it's where we watch movies, where we try to actually relax after a long day. But In the summer, it turns into a greenhouse. The afternoon sun just bakes this room and it stays hot and stuffy all evening.
We tried everything. We tried everything. Blackout curtains, portable AC, even just accepting that the summer is sticky and miserable. Nothing actually made it feel comfortable.

So when we came across Spin 360, I honestly didn't expect much, but The moment we turned it on, I was like, okay, wait, this is completely different. It doesn't blast you with a harsh stream. It gently moves the air around the entire room. Like the whole space can finally breathe. That heavy trapped feeling just disappears. It's not loud. It's not cold in one spot. It's just comfortable everywhere.

The kids stopped complaining about being too hot during movie night. I can actually sit down and unwind without feeling like I'm melting into the sofa. The air just feels softer, lighter, like you can finally exhale.
And I'm not going to lie, I was skeptical at first because we've tried so many things, but this one genuinely made a difference. We could actually feel.
This house has completely changed how summer feels, and honestly, anything that makes our home feel more comfortable for our family gets an A+ in my book.

So if you're looking for home upgrades that are actually worth it, this is the one I'd recommend. Follow along because we still have more we want to do, but for now, this is the best thing we've added all summer.

segments.text: Last summer, I hit a wall. Last summer, I hit a wall.
The moment my friend turned this on, I knew I was taking it home. The moment my friend turned this on, I knew I was taking it home.

I remember one morning specifically. My alarm went off and I just lay there staring at the ceiling, trying to find the energy to get out of bed. The kids were already up. I could hear them, and I just thought, I can't do this today. I'm a dad of 2, so there's no slow morning. There are lunches to make, someone's asking where their shoes are, someone needs breakfast, someone else is already late, and I'm supposed to be the one holding it all together.

But I was running on empty, and I knew exactly why. Our bedroom gets so hot in the summer, I'd go to bed exhausted, but I could never fully zone out. I'd throw the blanket off, turn from side to side, wake up sweating, then get up feeling like I'd barely slept. Then get up feeling like I'd barely slept. And it went on for weeks. Then about a month ago, a friend showed me something he'd just gotten. It was this fan, Spin 360. He turned it on and I immediately felt it. It cooled the whole room down, like the heat just started disappearing. He told me to take it home and try it.

transcript: Okay, do not fall for this fan. This thing is a scam. Let me explain. First, Spin 360 claims it can recreate that soft outdoor breeze feeling in your bedroom. You know, when you're outside on a quiet evening and the air

segments.text: Okay, do not fall for this fan. This thing is a scam. Let me explain.

First, Spin 360 claims it can recreate that soft outdoor breeze feeling in your bedroom. You know, when you're outside on a quiet evening and the air is just moving enough that your whole body kind of relaxes? That, which sounded extremely dramatic for a fan.

Then I found out it pulls air in from the top and the bottom and pushes it around the whole room instead of firing one of those aggressive streams directly at your face. And unfortunately, they were right.

It feels completely different. The air around— the air around the bed is just constantly moving, so I'm not doing that thing all night where I throw the blanket off, pull it back on top, flip over, get annoyed, repeat. Fine, one point for the Scam Fan.
Then there's the sound. At the lower speeds, it's ridiculously quiet. Turn it up and you get this soft, steady shh in the background. Traffic outside? Less noticeable.
At this point, I'm getting irritated because then you find out you can add one of these scent pods. So now the fan is moving an awesome scent around the bedroom too.
And within a few minutes, my room goes from, I threw my clothes on that chair again, to, a very put-together man definitely lives here.

Which brings me to the actual scam, calling Spin 360 a fan. Because when I hear fan, I picture some plastic thing blasting one side of my face while my hair gets thrown to the other side. This doesn't feel like that. It moves the air around the room. It gives me that soft background sound at night. It can make the whole bedroom smell good. And somewhere in there, yes, technically it is also a fan.
So seriously, do not fall for it. You'll order something to cool down your bedroom and somehow end up turning it into your favorite room in the house. Honestly, very misleading.

segments.text: Here are the 3 things that I do in summer to make sure the kids, me, and my hubby are knocked out by 8 PM at night so we can all get a good night's sleep. And you're gonna hear them and you're gonna be like, those seem stupid easy, and they are. So why the hell aren't you doing them?

Number 1, every morning I open up 2 windows on opposite sides of the house for 10 minutes. That's it. The cross breeze trades out all the stale air overnight and the house starts the day fresh instead of smelling like sleep.

Number 2, in summer, bedroom blinds close at 3 PM, not at bedtime, at 3 PM. An upstairs bedroom gets crazy hot by dinner if the sun sits on it all afternoon, and nobody, I mean nobody, can sleep in that heat.

transcript: Number 3, this is the one my friends always end up asking me about. My entire life motto is 2 birds, one stone. This thing kills 3. 20 minutes before bedtime, I turn on this fan in the kids' room. Bird one, it cools the

segments.text: Number 3, this is the one my friends always end up asking me about. My entire life motto is 2 birds, one stone. This thing kills 3.

20 minutes before bedtime, I turn on this fan in the kids' room. Bird one, it cools the whole room. It's a 360 fan, so it blows in every direction at once, so none of my kids have wind blasting in their face all night.
Bird 2, on the higher speeds, it makes this soft white noise my kids are obsessed with, so the sound machine is officially retired.

Bird 3, I drop a little scent pod in the top and the room smells heavenly. I mean heavenly. Let me tell you, this calms them down and it makes the whole house smell amazing. If you have a toddler, you already know why that matters. By the time books are done, their room is cool, it's humming, it smells clean, and they are knocked out.

Tip number 4, the second their lights go off, I set a 10-minute timer and clean the living room— toys, pillows, counters. When the timer ends, I'm done. And yes, the fan comes downstairs with me. It just picks up and moves. I kid you not, had this thing existed when my kids were younger, it would have saved me so many sleepless nights for them and for me, because damn, this thing makes me zoned out. It just feels so good.

transcript: So here's the thing I do to make my house smell like a 5-star wellness retreat, and I haven't seen anybody talk about this yet. I love my children. I would do anything for them. I mean anything. But I hate to say it, kid

segments.text: So here's the thing I do to make my house smell like a 5-star wellness retreat, and I haven't seen anybody talk about this yet.

I love my children. I would do anything for them. I mean anything. But I hate to say it, kids make a house smell. Nobody wants to say that out loud, so I will. I've got cleats and shin guards by the front door. I've got a 6-year-old who just played soccer in 90-degree heat, and I've got a stinky diaper pail situation upstairs. And then I cook dinner on top of all of that. Your guests notice that in 2 seconds.

So trust me when I say I've tried to fix this every way there is. Candles are pretty, but a candle is a little open flame around the children who made the smell. Room sprays last about 3 minutes, and a diffuser, a little cloud of mist over a sad little table.

Here's what actually worked: this thing right here. It looks like decor. I can place it wherever because it's not ugly, but it moves the air itself. It takes that heavy Jail, Cleats, and Dinner Air and pushes a gentle breeze with an actual nice scent through the entire room in a full circle. 30 seconds, okay? 30 seconds and it is a completely different house.

Of course I have a system: clean floral on normal nights, citrus when I want it feeling bright in here, and sandalwood when people are coming over because that is the one everybody asks about. 5 separate people have walked in and gone, how does your house smell this good with kids? 5.

And you know me, 2 birds, one stone. This kills 3. It smells amazing, it cools the room down, and it's quiet enough that has never once woken up a kid. So now after bedtime, lights low, fan on, and this house smells like a luxury spa. That's my secret.
Go look at the scents. I'm telling you.

title: Main Script x V4
description: A blonde woman in athletic wear speaks to the camera in a sunlit room. A black cylindrical fan sits on a table beside her.
transcript: So here's the— so here's the thing I do to make my house smell like a 5-star wellness retreat, and I haven't seen anybody talk about this yet. I love my children. I would do anything for them. I mean anything. But I hate

segments.text: So here's the— so here's the thing I do to make my house smell like a 5-star wellness retreat, and I haven't seen anybody talk about this yet.

I love my children. I would do anything for them. I mean anything. But I hate to say it, kids make a house smell. Nobody wants to say it out loud, so I will. I've got cleats and shin guards by the front door. I've got a 6-year-old who just played soccer in 90-degree heat, and I've got a stinky diaper pail situation upstairs. And then I cook dinner on top of all of that. Your guests notice that smell in 2 seconds.

So trust me when I say I've tried to fix this every way there is. Candles are pretty, but a candle is a little open flame around the same children who made the smell. Room sprays last about 3 minutes, and a diffuser, a little cloud of mist over one sad little table.

Here's what actually worked: this thing right here. It looks like decor. I can place it wherever because it's not ugly, but it moves the air itself. It takes that heavy stale cleats and dinner air and pushes a gentle breeze with an actual nice scent through the entire room in a full circle.

30 seconds, okay? 30 seconds and this is a different house. And of course I have a system: clean floral on normal nights, citrus when I want it feeling bright in here, and sandalwood when people are coming over, because that is the one everybody asks about.
5 separate people have walked in and gone, how does your house smell this good with kids? 5.

And you know me, 2 birds, one stone, this kills 3. It's smells amazing, cools the room down, and it's quiet enough that it has never once woken a kid up. So now after bedtime, lights low, fan on, and this house smells like a luxury spa. That's my secret.
Go look at all the scents. I'm telling you.

title: Main Script x V3
description: A woman in a leopard print dress speaks to the camera while sitting on a bed. She gestures frequently in a bright bedroom setting.
transcript: This thing does not feel like a fan, and I mean that in the best way possible. There's nothing blowing at you. It's like the windows are wide open on a perfect day, but without the bugs and the street noise. The whole ro

segments.text: This thing does not feel like a fan, and I mean that in the best way possible.

There's nothing blowing at you. It's like the windows are wide open on a perfect day, but without the bugs and the street noise. The whole room feels lighter, and this changes the whole atmosphere of the room.

In a house with kids, a normal fan points at one person and that person is winning, and everybody else is sweating and just mad about it. With this one, everybody is in the breeze at the same time. Nobody fights over it because there's nothing to point.

Here's what makes it different from any other fan you've ever tried. Every fan you have ever owned pulls air in one side and throws it out the other at one lucky person with that whop, whop, whop sound. That is not a breeze. Hot air lives at the top of your room, cold air lives at the floor. That is true in every room of your house right now. The Spin 360 pulls the hot air down, pushes the cool air up, and the entire room becomes one even temperature.
So no, I cannot tell you this fan makes you live longer, Nobody can. But a cool, quiet room that feels like sleeping outside every single night of the summer, that is worth every single penny for me.

title: script 2

transcript: I remember one morning specifically, my alarm went off and I just lay there staring at the ceiling trying to find the right energy to get out of bed. The kids were already up, I could hear them, and I just thought, I can

segments.text: I remember one morning specifically, my alarm went off and I just lay there staring at the ceiling trying to find the right energy to get out of bed. The kids were already up, I could hear them, and I just thought, I cannot do this today.

I'm a mom of 2, there's no slow morning. There's lunches to make, someone's asking where their shoes are, someone needs breakfast, someone else is already late. And I'm supposed to be the one holding it all together. But I was running on empty, and I knew exactly why. Our bedroom gets so hot in the summer. I'd go to bed exhausted, but I could never fully just zone out. I'd throw the blanket off, turn from side to side, wake up sweating, and then get up feeling like I'd barely even slept. And it went on for weeks. So I just accepted it. I thought, this is how summer is.

The heat just started disappearing. She told me to take it home and try it. That first night, I turned it on, got into bed, and just exhaled.

The air in my room was moving. I felt this soft, gentle coolness that filled the entire room. The air felt lighter. The atmosphere felt calmer. It felt like opening the windows on a quiet summer evening, like the effortless breeze that just lets you relax.

I slept through the night. No tossing, no turning. No waking up sweating. And the next morning, I woke up before my alarm. I actually felt ready. That morning, making lunches didn't feel as heavy. Finding someone's shoes didn't feel as frustrating. I had actual energy for my kids. I didn't realize how much the heat was draining me until it wasn't anymore.

So if the summer nights are stealing the energy that you need the next morning, You probably don't need air that blows harder, you just need the air around you to move differently, and that's exactly what Spin 360 does.

We tried everything— blackout curtains, portable AC, even just accepting that summer is sticky and miserable. Nothing actually made me feel comfortable.

The kids stopped complaining about being too hot during movie night. I can actually sit down and unwind without feeling like I'm melting into the sofa. The air just feels softer, lighter. You can finally exhale.

And I'm not gonna lie, I was skeptical at first because we've tried so many things, but this one made a difference we could actually feel. This fan has completely changed how summer feels. And anything that makes our home more comfortable for our family gets an A+ in my book.

So if you're looking for home upgrades that are actually worth it, this is the one I'd actually recommend. Follow along because we still have more to do, but for now, this is the best thing we've added all summer.

title: copy_70523289-0886-4303-A422-A8324FAD4B96
description: A woman in a tan cardigan speaks to the camera, gesturing with both hands in a modern living room.
transcript: So here's the thing I do to make my house smell like a 5-star wellness retreat, and I haven't seen anyone talk about this yet. I love my children, I would die for my children, but I hate to say it, kids make my house sme

segments.text: So here's the thing I do to make my house smell like a 5-star wellness retreat, and I haven't seen anyone talk about this yet.

I love my children, I would die for my children, but I hate to say it, kids make my house smell. Nobody wants to say that out loud, so I will. I've got cleats, shin guards by the front door. I've got a 7-year-old who just played football in 90-degree heat. I've got a diaper pail situation upstairs, and then I cook dinner on top of all all of it. Your guest notices that smell in 2 seconds.

So trust me when I say I try to fix this every way there is. Candles are pretty, but a candle is a little open flame around the same children who made the smell. Room sprays last about 3 minutes, and a diffuser— a little cloud of mist over one sad little table. Here's what actually worked:

this thing right here. It looks like decor. I can place it wherever, because it is not ugly, but it moves the air itself. It takes that heavy, stale cleats and dinner air and pushes a gentle breeze with an actual nice scent through the entire room in a full circle. 30 seconds, okay? 30 seconds and it's a different house.

And of course I have a system. Clean floral on normal nights, citrus when I want it feeling bright in here, sandalwood when people are coming over because that is the one everybody asks about, 5 separate people have walked in and gone, how does your house smell this good with kids?

title: copy_7967CCF9-5EB1-4CA0-B3D0-83870B68FDCC
description: Woman in denim shirt shares her experience with summer exhaustion.
transcript: Last summer I hit a wall. The moment my friend turned this on, I knew I was taking it home. I remember one morning specifically, my alarm went off and I was just laying there staring at the ceiling trying to find the ene

segments.text: Last summer I hit a wall. The moment my friend turned this on, I knew I was taking it home.

I remember one morning specifically, my alarm went off and I was just laying there staring at the ceiling trying to find the energy to get out of bed. The kids were already up, I could hear them, and I just thought, I cannot do this today. I'm a mama too, so there's no slow mornings. There are lunches to be made, someone asking where their shoes are, someone needs breakfast, someone else is already late, and I'm supposed to be the one holding it all together.

But I was running on empty, and I knew exactly why. Our bedroom gets so hot in the summer. I'd go to bed exhausted, but I could never fully zone out. I'd throw the blanket off, turn from side to side, waking up sweaty, then get up feeling like I'd barely slept. And it went on for weeks. I just accepted it. I thought, this is how summer is.

Then about a month ago, a friend showed me something she'd just gotten. It was this fan, Spin 360. She turned it on and I immediately felt it. It cooled the whole room down, like the heat just started disappearing. She told me to take it home and try it.

That first night, I turned it on, got into bed, and just exhaled. The air in my room was moving. I felt this soft, gentle coolness that filled the entire room. The air felt lighter, the atmosphere felt calmer. It felt like opening the windows on a quiet summer evening, that effortless that just lets you relax. I slept through the night, no tossing, no turning, no waking up sweating.

And the next morning, I woke up before my alarm. I actually felt ready that morning. Making lunches, it didn't feel as heavy. Finding someone's shoes didn't feel as frustrating. I actually had energy for my kids. I didn't realize how much the heat was draining me until it wasn't anymore.

So if summer nights are stealing the energy you need the next morning, you probably don't need air that's blowing harder. You need the air around you to move differently. And that's exactly what Spin 360 does.

description: Woman in a striped shirt talks to the camera in a bright room with a fan in the background.
transcript: Here are a few things that I do in summer to make sure the kids, me, and my hubby are knocked out by 8 PM at night so we get a good night's sleep. And you're gonna hear them and you're gonna be like, those seem stupid ea

segments.text: Here are a few things that I do in summer to make sure the kids, me, and my hubby are knocked out by 8 PM at night so we get a good night's sleep. And you're gonna hear them and you're gonna be like, those seem stupid easy, and they are. So why the hell aren't you doing them?

Number 1, every morning I open 2 windows on opposite sides of the house for 10 minutes. That's it. The cross breeze trades out all the stale overnight air and the house starts to smell fresh instead of smelling like sleep.

Number 2, in summer, bedroom blinds close at 3 PM. Not at bedtime, at 3. An upstairs bedroom goes crazy hot by dinner if the sun sits in it all afternoon, and nobody— I mean nobody— can sleep in that heat.
Number 3 is my friends always end up asking me about it. My entire life motto is 2 birds, one stone. This thing kills 3. 20 minutes before bed, I turn on the fan in the kids' room.
Bird 1, it cools the whole room. It's a 360 fan, so it blows in every direction at once, so none of the kids has wind blasting on their face all night.
Bird 2, on the higher speeds, it makes this soft white noise my kids are obsessed with, so the sound machine is officially retired.

Bird 3, I drop a little scent pod in the top and the room smells like heavenly, heavenly. Let me tell you, this Let me tell you, this calms them down and it makes the whole house smell amazing. If you have a toddler, you already know why that matters.
By the time books are done, the room is cool, it's humming, it smells clean, and they are knocked out.

Number 4, the second their lights go off, I set a 10-minute timer and clean the living room— toys, pillows, counters. When the timer ends, I'm done. And yes, the fan comes downstairs with me. It just picks up and moves.
I kid you not, had this thing existed when my kids were younger, it would have saved me sleepless nights from them and from me, because damn, this thing makes me zoned out. It just feels so good.

transcript: Do not fall for this fan. This thing is a scam. Let me explain. Spin 360 claims it can recreate that soft outdoor breeze feeling in your bedroom. You know what, when you're outside on a quiet summer evening and the air i

segments.text: Do not fall for this fan. This thing is a scam.

Let me explain. Spin 360 claims it can recreate that soft outdoor breeze feeling in your bedroom. You know what, when you're outside on a quiet summer evening and the air is just moving enough that your whole body kind of just relaxes? Yeah, that sounded extremely dramatic for a fan,
but it pulls air in from the top and the bottom and it pushes around the whole room instead of blasting one aggressive stream directly at your face.

And annoyingly, they were right. It feels completely different. The air around the bed is just constantly moving, so I'm not doing that thing all night where I throw the blanket off, put it back on, flip over, get annoyed, repeat. Fine, point one for the Scam Fan.
Then there's the sound. At the lower speeds, it's basically quiet. Turn it up and you get this soft, steady sound in the background. Traffic outside, less noticeable.

And now I'm getting irritated because then you find out you can add one of these scent pods. So now the fan can move an awesome scent around the bedroom too. Within a few minutes, my room goes from I threw everything on that chair again to a very put-together person definitely lives here.

Which brings me to the actual scam: calling Spin 360 a fan. Because when I hear fan, I picture some plastic thing blasting one side of my face while my hair gets stuck in my lip gloss. This doesn't feel like that. It moves air around the room. It gives me that soft background sound at night. It can make the whole room smell good. And somewhere in there, yes, it's also a fan.
So don't fall for it. You're ordering something to cool your bedroom and somehow end up turning it on in every room in the house. Honestly, very rude.

because here's the thing, our living room is where we spend all of our time. It's where the kids play, where we watch movies, where we try to actually relax after a long day. But in summer, it turns into a greenhouse. The afternoon sun just bakes this room and it stays hot and stuffy all evening.
We tried everything, blackout curtains, portable AC, even just accepting that summer is sticky and miserable. Nothing actually made it feel comfortable.
So when we came across Spin 360, I honestly didn't expect much, but the moment we turned it on, I was like, okay, wait, this is completely different.

It doesn't blast you with a harsh stream. It gently moves the air around the entire room like the whole space can finally breathe. That heavy trapped feeling just disappears. It's not loud, it's not cold in one spot, it's just comfortable everywhere.

The kids stopped complaining about being too hot during movie night. I can actually sit down and unwind without feeling like I'm melting into the sofa. The air just feels softer, lighter, and you can finally exhale.

And I'm not gonna lie, I was skeptical at first because we have tried so many things, but this one genuinely made a difference we could actually feel. This house has completely changed how Summer feels, and honestly, anything that makes our home feel more comfortable for our family gets an A+ in my book.
So if you're looking for home upgrades that are actually worth it, this is the one I'd actually recommend.
Follow along because we still have more we want to do, but for now, this is the best thing we've added all summer.

Your testosterone is being stolen while you sleep. Yeah, you heard that right.

I thought I was just a hot sleeper my entire life. It turns out your body relies on quality sleep to maintain healthy testosterone production. And a huge part of that is getting enough deep uninterrupted sleep. So when you sacrifice your sleep quality, you're also sacrificing one of the most important things supporting your testosterone. And if you're a guy, you do not want that.

Now, unfortunately for me, I do tend to sleep pretty hot. I'm talking flip the pillow 3 times, Kick the blanket off, one leg out of the covers hot. I mean, I didn't realize how much of that was actually messing with my sleep.

It turns out your body actually needs to lower its core temperature to fall asleep and stay asleep. So if you're overheating all night and constantly waking up, you're making good sleep way harder than it needs to be.

That's why I started using this. It's called Spin 360, and this is the weird part: it doesn't really feel like a fan. There isn't this one aggressive stream of air blasting your face or freezing one side of your body. The air just feels like it's moving everywhere— around your arms, around your legs, over the bed, through the whole room.

It's this soft, constant breeze that you feel on your skin without really noticing where it's coming from. And after a few minutes, the bedroom almost stops feeling closed in. It genuinely feels like somebody removed the walls and your bed is suddenly outside on one of those perfect summer nights.
Cool air is moving all around you. Nothing is blasting you. Nothing feeling stagnant. Just this constant smooth breeze while you sleep.

That's why I sleep with it every night now. Because if I'm already going out spending money on protein, creatine, supplements, and everything else trying to optimize my body, I'm definitely not ignoring the 8 hours that matter most.

description: Infant sleeps in a white crib while sunlight filters through blinds.
transcript: New moms, this is one thing I wish I added to the nursery sooner. My baby used to wake up so easily, every little sound, every tiny change in the room. So we added this fan to the nursery, and honestly, it completely cha

segments.text: New moms, this is one thing I wish I added to the nursery sooner. My baby used to wake up so easily, every little sound, every tiny change in the room.
So we added this fan to the nursery, and honestly, it completely changed how comfortable the room feels.

The first thing I noticed was how soft and natural the airflow feels. It doesn't feel like a regular fan blowing air around the room. It feels more like a gentle breeze. It's so gentle, I feel comfortable keeping it by the crib.
On the lower settings, you can barely hear it, and when I want a little background sound, I turn it up and it creates this soft white noise, kind of soothing, honestly.
Honestly, it's seriously become one of my favorite things in the nursery. If you're setting up a nursery, I'd definitely add this.
